#summary Downloads and Update Site of the EMF Client Platform (ECP)

This site contains releases and nightly builds of the ECP. Currently there are only nightly builds.

==Nightly builds==

The ECP features can be installed from this update site:

*EMF Client Platform requires a workspace persistency layer. Please install the feature "EMF Client Platform" , which includes the EMFStore Workspace as a default. We will release an XMI persistence workspace soon.*

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/ecpNightly http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/emfstoreNightly]

==New and Noteworthy==

0.7.0.nightly

  * Added support for multi-attribute types
  * refactored workspace model

0.6.3.nightly:

  * Added XMI persistence (Beta)

0.5.18.nightly:

  * Added extension points to release
